hero.title: Colour that holds, a cut that suits you
hero.imageAlt: Long hair in motion, photographed in black and white

features.title: What I do every day
features.description: Six things that come up almost daily. For anything else, we talk it through before starting.
features.imageAlt: Shampoo at the basin, before the cut

colorimetry.title: Colour theory
colorimetry.description: I read the underlying pigment before applying anything. That is what keeps out the orange tones nobody wants.

airTouch.title: Air Touch
airTouch.description: Strands are sorted with a hairdryer before being lightened. Regrowth spreads out gently, without leaving a hard line.

cut.title: Cut and blow-dry
cut.description: A cut that follows your hairline and the density of your hair, so it falls back into place on its own the next day.

bridal.title: Bridal updo
bridal.description: A trial before the day itself, the hold checked with the veil, and photos so the same style can be rebuilt on the morning.

care.title: Care and bio-aesthetics
care.description: The treatment depends on the real state of your lengths, not on whatever is on offer this month.

diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
diagnosis.description: Ten minutes before starting: what you have already had done, the state of the hair, and what will need a second session.

pricing.title: The prices
pricing.description: Shampoo included. If your hair is very long or very dense it sometimes takes an extra dose of product, and I tell you before we start.
pricing.imageAlt: A sharp red bob against a black background

credentials.title: Where I trained
credentials.description: Three qualifications, one of them earned in Moscow. That is what lets me tell you whether a colour will hold, or not.
credentials.imageAlt: Blow-dry at the end of an appointment

cap.label: Vocational diploma
cap.title: Hairdressing
cap.description: The basis of the trade: cutting, setting and blow-drying, repeated until the hand is sure of itself.

professionalCertificate.label: Professional certificate
professionalCertificate.title: Colour theory
professionalCertificate.description: Colour approached as arithmetic: underlying pigment, neutralisation, how well it holds over time.

bioAesthetics.label: Certificate, Moscow
bioAesthetics.title: Bio-aesthetics
bioAesthetics.description: A way of approaching hair through the scalp and the fibre, learned during training in Russia.

testimonials.title: What they say about it
testimonials.description: The reviews published on the salon's Google listing, quoted as they are. Hover over the band to stop it scrolling.

colourHold.author: Marine L.
colourHold.quote: My colour has held for two months without turning. It is the first time somebody explained why before starting, rather than just what it would cost.

airTouch.author: Sophie B.
airTouch.quote: Air Touch on already bleached lengths: three hours, but the regrowth still does not show. She warned me it might take two sessions, and in the end one was enough.

bridal.author: Camille D.
bridal.quote: A trial a month before, photos to go with it, and the updo held from the morning right through the evening. Nothing needed fixing all day.

listening.author: Nadia K.
listening.quote: I turned up with a Pinterest photo and she told me straight what was doable on my hair. We adapted it, and I like the result far better than the photo.

firstVisit.author: Élodie M.
firstVisit.quote: A proper diagnosis before touching anything. A change from salons where you are sat down and cut without a single question.

kids.author: Julien P.
kids.quote: I have been taking my daughter there for a year, and she used to refuse to go to the hairdresser at all. Patience and good humour are enough to win her over.

transformations.title: Transformations, not touch-ups
transformations.description: Every appointment starts from the real state of the hair and moves towards a result that lasts. The salon photographs are on their way, the drawings below stand in until then.

brownToBlonde.title: From brown to ash blonde
brownToBlonde.description: Two sessions three weeks apart, a gradual lightening and a cool toner to neutralise the warm tones. The lengths stayed healthy.
brownToBlonde.afterAlt: Ash blonde reached after two sessions

regrowth.title: Regrowth that no longer shows
regrowth.description: Air Touch on a dark base: strands are sorted with a hairdryer before being lightened, so the line spreads out instead of marking.
regrowth.afterAlt: Blended regrowth after the Air Touch

bobCut.title: The bob that falls back on its own
bobCut.description: A cut drawn on the real hairline and density, not on a template. The next day, one pass of the brush is enough.

bridalUpdo.title: Bridal updo, trial included
bridalUpdo.description: A trial before the day itself, the hold checked with the veil, and photos so the same style can be rebuilt on the morning.

duration.question: How much time should I set aside?
duration.answer: An hour and a half for a simple colour on medium-length hair, up to three hours for an Air Touch on long hair. I block the slot accordingly: there are never two appointments at the same time.

colorChange.question: Can I go from brown to blonde in one sitting?
colorChange.answer: Rarely. It all depends on what your hair has already been through. Most of the time it takes two or three spaced-out sessions to get there without breaking the lengths, and I tell you at the diagnosis.

payment.question: How can I pay?
payment.answer: Cash or card, at the salon. There is no deposit to pay when you book.

cancel.question: What if I have to cancel?
cancel.answer: A call or a message, that is all. Letting me know the day before means I can offer the slot to somebody else.

access.question: Where is the salon?
access.answer: In Hoenheim, just north of Strasbourg. The exact address and the map are at the bottom of this page.
